index.placeholder: Select an alert from the list, or create a new one.

discardModal.title: Unsaved changes
discardModal.message: If you leave now, your progress will be lost. Would you like to save this alert as a draft before leaving?

deleteModal.title: Delete this alert?
deleteModal.message: This removes the alert and all its bundles. This cannot be undone.

wizard.communicationHintSuffix: — how this source talks to the alert system.

webhookInfo.title: Webhook URL
webhookInfo.body: uses a webhook. Nothing more to configure here — a unique URL will be generated once you save the alert, and you can paste it into the source's outgoing-webhook settings. The URL will appear in this alert's view page after save.

bundleStep.intro: A {bundle} is one notification target: a set of discussions plus a message format.
bundleStep.warnHint: ⚠ Some bundles have no discussions selected — this alert will be saved as a {draft} until every bundle has at least one discussion.

footer.saveAlertTitle: Save the alert and return to view mode
footer.saveAsDraftTitle: Save as draft and return to view mode

view.noBundles: No bundles configured. Click {editAlert} to add one.

condition.summaryRuleAll: Fires when all of these fields {phrase}.
condition.summaryRuleAny: Fires when any of these fields {phrase}.
condition.summaryRuleAllMissingValue: Fires when all of these fields {phrase} (value missing — edit to set).
condition.summaryRuleAnyMissingValue: Fires when any of these fields {phrase} (value missing — edit to set).

testPanel.intro: Trigger the polling pipeline once manually. The alert won't be activated and no bundles will be fired — the result will open in a panel showing the per-field breakdown and the message each bundle would send.

testModal.title: Test poll result
testModal.conditionNotMet: Condition not met — alert would not fire.

bundleModal.title: Edit bundle {n}
bundleModal.discardWarning: ⚠ Discard unsaved changes to this bundle?

watchedFields.label: Watched fields
watchedFields.hint: Type a path, or use {dotdot} as a wildcard (e.g. {example} matches every day's max). Or open the picker to choose visually.
watchedFields.inputPlaceholder: paste or type a path, then Enter

summary.noFields: No fields watched — click values in the source.
summary.noMatch: Watched patterns don't match any paths in the source. Refresh or fix the pattern.
summary.changedNeedsBaseline: Change is detected at poll time (needs a baseline). Watching {n} field.
summary.changedNeedsBaselinePlural: Change is detected at poll time (needs a baseline). Watching {n} fields.
summary.wouldFireAll: Would fire — all of {total} field verified ({passing}/{total}).
summary.wouldFireAllPlural: Would fire — all of {total} fields verified ({passing}/{total}).
summary.wouldFireAny: Would fire — more than one of {total} field verified ({passing}/{total}).
summary.wouldFireAnyPlural: Would fire — more than one of {total} fields verified ({passing}/{total}).
summary.wouldNotFireRequiresAll: Would not fire — {passing} of {total} field verified, this condition requires all.
summary.wouldNotFireRequiresAllPlural: Would not fire — {passing} of {total} fields verified, this condition requires all.
summary.wouldNotFireRequiresAny: Would not fire — {passing} of {total} field verified, this condition requires at least one.
summary.wouldNotFireRequiresAnyPlural: Would not fire — {passing} of {total} fields verified, this condition requires at least one.
